gizmo.title: Liis hubin dhibcood
gizmo.description: Liis sanduuqyo calaamadeed. Akhristayaashu waxay calaamadeeyaan shayada horumarkoodana waxaa lagu xasuustaa qalabkooda.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Magaca liiska. Waxaa kor loogu akhriyaa sida calaamadda kooxda sanduuqyada.

configure.title: Shayada
configure.description: Shay kastaa waa sanduuq calaamadeed. Shayada la calaamadeeyay ama la xannibay akhristayaashu ma beddeli karaan.

configure.title: Tirsan
configure.description: Muuji liis tirsan halkii liis dhibcood.

configure.title: Xaalad
configure.description: Wuxuu beddelaa midabada si ay ula jaan qaadaan stop-note.

developer.title: ID-ga kaydinta
developer.description: ID gaar ah oo loo isticmaalo xusuusta horumarka akhristaha ee qalabkiisa. Si otomaatig ah ayaa loo sameeyaa; beddel oo keliya si aad horumarka ugu wadaagto liisaska ama aad u bilowdo cusub.
